column1: # Reconnaissance for the fire/land-use option. NO model change was made.
# GFED4.1S burned area (ILAMB, 0.5 deg, 240 monthly records) sampled at every
# land column of the global equilibrium map (job 6978605), binned by OBSERVED
# excess_per_cell = model_mean - obs_mean (kg C m-2); total_excess = n * excess.
# Burned area is NON-monotonic: it peaks in the 0.5-2 bin and is low in the
# driest bin, because true desert has no fuel. Fire cannot explain the arid end.
# But the bins where burned area peaks (0.5-5) carry 70% of all excess carbon,
# while the driest bin carries only 16% - the ratio metric overweights arid
# cells where the absolute carbon involved is small.
